significant expression changes of high light inducible (hli) genes resulted from shifts in O2:CO2 ratio (Bagby and Chisholm, 2015) (Introduction, p2)

there was a significant decrease in the expression of the Ohr family peroxiredoxin (Supplementary Tables 3 and 4), which is thought to degrade organic peroxides (Results, p10)
